params.QUERY: SELECT column_name,datatype,description FROM TAP_SCHEMA.columns WHERE table_name='dr4.images'

body:
column_name,datatype,description
airmass,REAL,Airmass of the exposure centre taken from the telescope
background,REAL,Average background counts for the exposure
zpapprox,REAL,Approximate photometric zeropoint for the exposure (appropriate for centre of mosaic)
zp_fitstars,INTEGER,Number of stars in photometric zeropoint for the exposure
zp_gradient_x,REAL,Gradient in photometric zeropoint in x_mosaic coordinate
zp_gradient_y,REAL,Gradient in photometric zeropoint in y_mosaic coordinate
wcs_fitstars,REAL,Number of stars in WCS solution for mosaic
wcs_rms,REAL,RMS in WCS solution for mosaic
date,DOUBLE,Modified Julian Date at the start of the exposure
decl,DOUBLE,Declination of the exposure centre taken from the telescope
elong_mean,REAL,Average elongation (A/B) for the exposure
exp_time,REAL,Exposure time
field_id,INTEGER,SkyMapper field ID
filter,CHAR,SkyMapper photometric filter (uvgriz)
fwhm_mean,REAL,Average full width at half maximum for the exposure
image_id,BIGINT,Unique image ID as used by the Science Data Pipeline
image_type,CHAR,Image type: ms=Main Survey - fs=Shallow Survey - std=Standard Field - 3ps=Non-survey Image - bad=Bad-seeing Image
img_qual,SMALLINT,Quality level of this image from 1=best to 3=worst
night_mjd,INTEGER,Truncated Modified Julian Date at the start of night
object,CHAR,Survey/field/image_type identifier (not unique)
ra,DOUBLE,Right Ascension of the exposure centre taken from the telescope
rotator_pos,REAL,Angular position of the instrument rotator
zp_rms,REAL,RMS in photometric zeropoint for the exposure
